verdict.rationale: The SDK CLI docs claim you can 'explore and run actions... directly from your terminal' (zapier-docs-27), which offers a runnable-example-like experience, but there is no evidence of an actual interactive API reference (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI try-it console) — the openapi probe found only 404s across all candidate spec URLs. missing for 10: a browsable interactive API reference UI, OpenAPI/Swagger spec, in-browser runnable request examples.
